purpose: Five pre-generated theme illustrations, matched locally to confirmed page content. No runtime generation or private financial data sent to image generation.

prompts.daily-coffee-lunch: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: one finished editorial illustration for an interactive Chinese spending journal, November 1 page with only coffee and lunch expenses. Primary request: an intimate still life of a simple ceramic coffee cup, a small lunch plate with sandwich and greens, and a casually folded linen napkin. NO other purchased objects. Medium: sophisticated gouache and colored pencil illustration on smooth ivory paper, hand-painted uneven pigment edges and restrained graphite lines, an observational art-book drawing, warm umber, muted olive, cream, small rust-red accents. Composition: a single cohesive wide still life, aspect ratio 3:2, fully visible objects gathered around center, plenty of clean ivory margins; no borders, no tape, no lettering, no numbers, no receipts, no logos, no collage of panels, no UI. No people. Soft morning side light, subtle sparse shadows, quiet refined handmade sketchbook quality. Surface must be fine-grained, never chunky grunge. This is symbolic category art, not a photograph or evidence of actual purchased food.
